svg.title: Epic Breakdown Canvas
svg.desc: A3 landscape canvas: epic hypothesis, outcomes, MVP, five feature cards with size and MVP flags, first stories, out-of-scope items and NFRs, and dependencies and risks.
svg.text: Turn a big idea into an MVP, a handful of valuable features, and the first stories a team can start.
